source_artifact: NVBit v1.7.6 tracer tool tested with compiled CUDA binary and PyTorch Python script
provenance: NVBit v1.7.6 on RTX 5090 (Blackwell sm_120). Previously generated traces exist from April 12 (manual-l1_bw_32f-5090-fixed) proving NVBit worked on this hardware.

smoke_test_results.failure_reason: NVBit loads (banner confirmed), BERT inference runs correctly on GPU, but no .pb files are written to TRACES_FOLDER. Same behavior observed with compiled CUDA binary (l1_bw_32f) that previously produced traces on April 12. Likely a driver update (580.x) broke NVBit v1.7.6 output path while preserving injection.
Same as above — NVBit loads but produces zero-byte traces/ directory. The previously-generated manual-l1_bw_32f-5090-fixed trace from April 12 confirms NVBit previously worked.

manual-l1_bw_32f-5090-fixed.status: available — proves NVBit worked on this hardware previously

resolution: NVBit v1.7.6 loads (banner confirmed) and intercepts CUDA calls, but trace file output is broken on driver 580.105.08. The existing April 12 traces prove the hardware is capable. Resolution: debug NVBit output path on current driver, or downgrade driver to the version that was active on April 12.
